name: files.write
description: Create or overwrite a text/code file inside an allowed workspace root after explicit approval. Use for natural edit requests such as putting text in README.md, creating test.md with content, or modifying source code.

args_schema.path: absolute path inside allowed roots or path relative to current workspace
args_schema.content: full text content to write into the file
args_schema.overwrite: true only when replacing an existing file after explicit approval
